name: AlarmFlow
description: Timers and alarms. They ring on this computer while BuildBot runs, even with no page open.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.create_timer: Start a countdown timer for some hours, minutes and seconds, up to 7 days. It rings on this computer.
tools.create_alarm: Set an alarm for a clock time (24-hour), today or tomorrow, once or repeating.
tools.list: List the timers and alarms that are set, with the time left on each.
tools.snooze: Snooze a ringing timer or alarm for some minutes, up to 24 hours.
tools.add_time: Add minutes to a running timer or alarm, or take some off with a negative number, up to 24 hours either way.
tools.dismiss: Stop a ringing timer or alarm, or cancel one that is set. A ringing repeating alarm moves to its next day.
tools.dismiss_all: Stop and cancel every timer and alarm.
tools.delete: Delete a timer or alarm for good, by its name.

create_timer: set a timer for ten minutes for the pasta
create_alarm: set an alarm for 6:30 in the morning to wake up
list: what timers are running right now
snooze: snooze the wake up alarm for ten minutes
add_time: add five more minutes to the pasta timer
dismiss_all: cancel all my timers and alarms
delete: delete the wake up alarm for good

setup_steps.title: Let AlarmFlow play sound
setup_steps.why: Browsers stay silent until you tap a page once. Open AlarmFlow and tap Test sound.

consent: AlarmFlow keeps your timers and alarms in its own data folder on this computer and rings them here. It does not use the internet.
